request: Create a visual representation of a concealed-shutter TV unit inspired by the supplied reference, sized to the approved living-room TV-wall constraints.
proposal: Draft one front-facing living-room visual: a 75-inch TV in a full-height warm off-white and taupe textured joinery composition, flanked by two shallow 460 mm-wide outward-opening concealed-storage shutters. Preserve the W5 clearance, stair-wall placement, low ventilated console and the existing puja relationship.
risks_and_dependencies: The concept render is not a fabrication drawing and cannot establish final joinery dimensions.
The current model has only 61 mm clearance from the TV backing to W5; no shutter or end panel may invade the window reveal.
Final shutter swing, ceiling height, masonry bracket fixing, cable routes and equipment ventilation need site verification.
validation_plan: Check the generated visual retains the 75-inch TV, clear W5 side, closed service storage and no change to walls, puja or circulation.
Present as a concept-only draft for user review; no promotion is requested.

results: Suitable as a concept-only draft; no baseline changes were made.
The render broadly communicates the 75-inch TV within the approved 2,810 mm console envelope, but cannot certify dimensions or the 61 mm W5 clearance.
Confirm shutter swing at W5, actual ventilation/free area, service access, TV bracket fixing and cable routing through a measured shop drawing.

open_next_actions: Preserve as withdrawn draft history; do not use for design or fabrication.
